title: SCRIPT//GO native module
description: An integrator's natives, described once (name, parameters, results, side, permission). A host kit exposes them to every guest language as ScriptGo.natives.<module>.<function> and generates their typings. Read by ScriptGo.Host NativeModule.FromJson; handlers are bound in code after reading. The kit ignores members it does not know; this schema refuses them to catch typos. Rules the schema cannot express are checked at registration: a module name is registered once per host, function names are unique within a module, a required parameter cannot follow an optional one, every function has a handler bound, and a global module cannot take a name the runtime uses (ScriptGo, Open77, exports, source, print, console, promise, Citizen, json, string, table, math, os, utf8, bit, require, globalThis, JSON, Math, Promise, Object, Array).

name.description: The module name: ScriptGo.natives.<name>. invoke is reserved (ScriptGo.natives.invoke).

global.description: Also expose the module as a global of that name.

capability.description: An extension capability the host gains by registering the module, so manifests can require it.

type.description: A value type: nil, boolean, integer, number, string, table or any; T[] is a list of T (an empty table passes); T? also accepts nil. Arguments are checked against it before the handler runs (invalid_argument:<name>).

name.description: Used in invalid_argument:<name> and in the typings.

side.description: Where it may be called; elsewhere the call fails with native_unavailable_on_side:<side>.

permission.description: A permission the resource must declare in its manifest and the operator must grant (HostOptions.GrantPermission); otherwise the call fails with permission_denied:<permission>.

params.description: In order. A call with more non-nil arguments than declared fails with invalid_argument_count.

returns.description: The result types, for the typings: one type, or a list for several values.
